ctaText: Design Your Perfect Couples Golf Journey

faqs.q: Is Vietnam a good destination for a couple where only one plays golf?
faqs.a: Vietnam — particularly the Da Nang and Hoi An region — is one of the world's best destinations for a golfer/non-golfer couple. While the golfer plays at Hoiana Shores or Ba Na Hills, the non-golfing partner has access to Hoi An Ancient Town UNESCO heritage experiences, An Bang Beach, cooking schools, spa treatments, and tailoring boutiques. Few destinations balance both so well.

faqs.q: What can non-golfers do in Hoi An while their partner plays golf?
faqs.a: Hoi An Ancient Town alone is worth a 2-day visit. Beyond the town itself: Red Bridge Cooking School (half-day cooking class with market foraging), Thu Bon River boat trip, personal tailoring appointments (Hoi An is Vietnam's premium tailoring capital), An Bang beach, and Fusion Maia spa. AGS designs parallel itineraries for non-golfing partners.

faqs.q: Is Thailand good for a couple where only one plays golf?
faqs.a: Extremely. Hua Hin offers beach access, Chiva-Som wellness, Night Market, Cicada Market, and excellent coastal restaurants. Phuket adds Old Town cultural experiences, beach club access, snorkelling, and Ao Phang-Nga National Park. Non-golfing partners in Thailand are rarely at a loss for exceptional activities.

faqs.q: What accommodation works best for couples on a golf holiday?
faqs.a: For couples, AGS recommends a private pool villa rather than hotel accommodation. The villa's private outdoor space — pool, garden, covered sala for meals — creates a romantic base that serves as the social hub of the trip. A villa with a living area allows the golfer to return from an early round while the partner enjoys a late morning in private surroundings.

faqs.q: Can I adjust the golf schedule to have more shared couple time?
faqs.a: Absolutely — AGS designs all itineraries around your priorities. For couples, we typically schedule morning golf rounds (7am tee, back by 1pm) that leave the afternoon free for shared activities. Golf on Days 2, 4, and 6 with shared cultural/leisure days on Days 1, 3, 5 is a common couple-friendly pattern.

The model is straightforward: morning golf for the player (typically 7am tee, back before 1pm), shared afternoons and evenings. On rest days, shared experiences. The trip works for both because neither is compromising.

Why Vietnam Works for Couples

The Da Nang / Hoi An region is our default recommendation for golfer-and-partner couples, and for good reason. The non-golfing partner has access to one of Southeast Asia's most compelling cultural environments while the golfer plays what is genuinely one of the world's best concentrated golf circuits.

The Golfer's Days

  • 7am tee time at Hoiana Shores
  • Ba Na Hills Night Golf (evening)
  • BRG or Montgomerie morning rounds
  • Post-round villa pool from 1pm

The Partner's Days

  • Hoi An Ancient Town sunrise stroll
  • Red Bridge Cooking School
  • Personal tailoring appointment
  • An Bang beach morning + spa afternoon

Hoi An: The Non-Golfer's Paradise

Hoi An Ancient Town is Vietnam's most enchanting destination — a UNESCO World Heritage site that has preserved its 15th-century trading port character in remarkable detail. The Japanese Covered Bridge, silk traders, tailor houses, and lantern-lit waterfront create an environment unlike anything in Southeast Asia.

For non-golfing partners, Hoi An offers a suite of engaging activities: the Red Bridge Cooking School runs half-day classes combining a local market visit with Vietnamese cooking instruction; the town's 60+ tailoring boutiques offer bespoke clothing in 48-hour turnaround; the nearby Champa Spa is excellent for afternoon treatments.

AGS includes a joint dinner recommendation list for every Hoi An itinerary — the evening shared around a waterfront table at The Field restaurant or Cargo Club is as good as any restaurant experience in Vietnam.

The Ideal Couple-Friendly 7-Day Vietnam Structure

Day 1: Arrival, villa check-in, shared beach dinner at An Bang
Day 2: GOLF — Hoiana Shores (golfer), Hoi An Ancient Town (partner). Shared: evening dinner in Hoi An
Day 3: SHARED — Red Bridge Cooking School together. Afternoon: villa pool + spa
Day 4: GOLF — BRG Norman (golfer), An Bang beach + tailoring (partner). Shared: sunset cocktails at Rosewood
Day 5: GOLF — Ba Na Hills Night Golf 5:30pm (both travel to the mountain; partner explores Ba Na Hills resort while golfer plays the 18). Shared evening experience
Day 6: GOLF — Montgomerie Links (golfer), My Son Heritage Site tour (partner). Farewell dinner at The Field
Day 7: Departure

Every element of the above is adjustable — fewer golf rounds, more shared days, different cultural experiences. AGS designs the couple's trip as carefully as the group tour, because the dynamics are equally demanding.
